label: Image Analysis
title: Image Analysis
subtitle: Sends an image to a vision-capable AI model and returns a natural-language description or answer. Useful for extracting information from screenshots, diagrams, charts, photos, or scanned documents.
whenToUse: Use when an agent needs to understand the content of an image — reading text from a screenshot, describing a graph, analysing a photo, or extracting structured data from a scanned form.

methods.name: Analyse Image
methods.description: Sends an image (file path or URL) along with an optional question to a vision model and returns the response.

mediaCaption: An Image Analysis action card showing the image thumbnail, the prompt sent, and the text description returned
tips: Ask specific questions for better results: "What is the value in the top-right cell of this table?" is more useful than "describe this image".
Works well with screenshots taken by the Browser Automation tool.
